text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also a little stressful. You need to choose a place, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try food you have never tasted before. Sometimes you face language barriers, and you have to use gestures or simple words to communicate. These moments can be funny and teach you a lot. In the end, travel gives you unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. That is why so many people love exploring new places every year.
